Wind Style: Rasen Shuriken. You compress your chakra into a Rasengan studded with cellular-level wind blades, then hurl it. On detonation, every cell in the impact area is shredded.

Make a spell attack roll against a creature within 60 feet. On a hit, the Rasenshuriken detonates in a 10-foot burst centered on the target. Creatures in the area take 12d10 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save; the original target counts as critically failing the save (no save at all).

Any creature that fails or critically fails the save is also enfeebled 1 for 1 minute as their chakra pathways are perforated.

If you throw Rasenshuriken yourself (rather than have a clone deliver it), you take 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier slashing damage from the recoil. Naruto's later sage-mode variant ignores this cost.
